tee_title: Viking Queen Shirt, Norwegian Forest Cat Tee, Wegie Cat Lover T-Shirt, Norse Cat Gift for Cat Mom, Cat Year 2027
tee_desc:
VIKING QUEEN over nine photos of the Norwegian Forest Cat, the Wegie of Norse legend and the cat said to have pulled the goddess Freya's chariot. From Cat Year 2027 by Raining Cats & Dogs. The back tells the breed's story, with its facts and a QR code to this week's page at rainingcad.com.

A soft, comfortable unisex tee in a classic fit. Printed on white. Fits true to size. Size up for a looser fit.

A good gift for a cat mom, a Norwegian Forest Cat owner, a Viking fan or anyone who loves a fluffy cat.

Care: machine wash cold, inside out. Tumble dry low. Do not iron the print.
